description: Land Acquisition - Wathumulla, Walapane D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including location details, lot numbers, land use, extent, and claimant information. It serves as a formal notice to interested parties regarding the acquisition and compensation process, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
